data.title: Apple Takes Aim at AI Agents, Wants Mac Users to Know When Their Data Is Accessed as Meta Tackles Muse Privacy Claims
data.description: Apple plans to update macOS to clearly notify users whenever AI agents attempt to access their system data.

data.title: Saudi Arabia Plans Strike Against Tehran-Backed Houthis To Secure Red Sea Route as US-Iran Conflict Disrupts Global Shipping
data.description: Saudi Arabia is weighing an offensive against Iran-backed Houthis as the U.S.-Iran conflict disrupts the Strait of Hormuz and increases pressure on the Red Sea route.

data.title: Exclusive: Trump's Diesel Price Dilemma isn't About Supply — Expert Says It's Because 'Fuel is in the Wrong Place'
data.description: U.S. diesel prices stay high despite surplus production as costly distribution and transport bottlenecks drive prices, expert says.
